review.intent_summary: Robust mode limits extreme observations' influence on trend fitting, residual calibration, and later seasonal references.

criteria.criterion: Robust seasonal references reduce the influence of an extreme prior matching seasonal value.
Training and calibration diagnostics identify excluded extreme observations.
An extreme evaluated sample remains evidence while its expected value is used in future references.
Callers can choose include mode to retain raw extreme observations and inspect the resulting echo behavior.
